div.div:
Built with lag() over peiljaar per gemeente_code:
every name change starts a new version, and the
running sum over those markers is the version number.
Custom tests check that periods are contiguous,
do not overlap and that at most one version is current.

text.tspan: Built with lag() over peiljaar per gemeente_code:
every name change starts a new version, and the
running sum over those markers is the version number.
Custom tests check that periods are contiguous,
do not overlap and that at most one version is current.
